    Left-click / drag
    Select, box-select
    
        
    Right-click
    Move, attack, gather, build
    
        
    Double-click
    Select all of that type on screen
    
        
    Z then click
    Attack-move (X stops)
    
        
    .
    Next idle citizen
    
        
    H
    Jump to your Capitol
    
        
    Ctrl/Shift + 1–9
    Make a group; 1–9 recalls
    
        
    WASD, edges
    Move the camera; wheel zooms
    
        
    Middle-drag
    Rotate and tilt the camera
    
        
    M
    Sound on or off
    
      
    
      
    Spears beat horsemen, horsemen beat archers, archers beat spears. Your Capitol and towers shoot back. Every unit eats food each minute: run out and your people starve. Grow from village to empire by building (K shows the tech tree), and win by conquest or by finishing a Wonder.

    Each building unlocks the next. There are no upgrades to research: build it, and its bonus applies to your whole civilization. Finish the Wonder to win without conquering anyone.
